dialogues.speaker: Joliot
dialogues.text: Oh Archons, please grant us a healthy and wise child!

dialogues.speaker: Irimia
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, I wouldn't ask for intelligence or talent, but please, may our child live a peaceful life!

dialogues.speaker: Joliot
dialogues.text: Uh, honey, is it just me, or did you ask for more than I did, somehow?

dialogues.speaker: Irimia
dialogues.text: Shh, you'll jinx it! Also, what's so excessive about asking that our child grow up well?

dialogues.speaker: Joliot
dialogues.text: That's not what I'm saying, it's just, in light of that "prophecy"...

dialogues.speaker: Irimia
dialogues.text: But it's just a legend, and not something that will happen for sure, right?
